packageRules.description: Minor+patch chart bumps: one grouped weekly PR - batch the boring changes into a single review

Chart majors stay isolated: one PR per chart, opened immediately (no weekly batching), always human-reviewed, never automerged. Chart semver marks packaging/values-schema breaks, not app risk - judge each against its upstream changelog.
Container image bumps across app manifests (apps/*.yaml): one grouped weekly PR so you can review the docker tag changes in a single diff. No automerge.

Container image majors stay isolated and labeled: human-reviewed, never automerged. Note: hermes-agent uses date-style tags (v2026.8.18) that Renovate may bucket as 'major' since they aren't semver - that's expected.
